Wayfare — Home, 3 unique cinematic structures (one dark palette, focus on layout)
Each avoids the greeting-card-list pattern and the side-accent-bar card.
① Immersive Cover — the whole screen is the trip; a floating live ‘boarding pass’; swipe-up peek; gesture dock.
② Reel — your day as a vertical filmstrip; the NOW frame expands, done frames dim above, upcoming below.
③ Editorial — type-led magazine; huge serif masthead, offset image, numbered ‘programme’ index.
④ Atlas — map-home; your route on the map, photo pins, ‘near you’ recommendations, gesture dock.
